scope.title: Exterior Grilles and Screens (Sec 10 8213)
scope.text: Furnish and install mechanical roof screen system: galvanized steel post supports (16), 304 SS post caps, structural steel tube framing (240 LF), 7.2 Rib Galvalume/PVDF panels (480 SF), 304 SS connectors and hardware, panel trim, and TPO roof flashings. BOD: RoofScreen Mfg SC3R Cantilevered Three-Member Frame or CityScapes Envisor.

scope.title: Deferred Structural Submittal
scope.text: Provide structural design calculations by WA-licensed PE for screen framing, base reactions, and attachment to existing roof structure per ASCE 7 loads for Des Moines WA site.

exclusions: Structural steel framing (Section 05 1200 DELETED per Addendum No. 1 - confirmed no structural steel on this project).
Miscellaneous metals not shown on drawings for screen system.
Roofing repair or modification beyond TPO post flashings.
Electrical connections to mechanical equipment behind screens.
Painting of concealed structural members (shop primer only).
Countertop brackets (Rakks EH Series - listed as alternate if furnished by metals sub; by countertop sub unless directed otherwise).
assumptions: Roof screen quantities are BUDGET estimates based on plan elevations A4.01/A4.02 and building section A5.01. This is a deferred submittal item - final quantities per manufacturer layout and PE calculations.
Two screen areas assumed per elevations: approx 52' and 72' runs at approx 4' average height.
Post count (16) estimated at 8 per screen area. Final count per structural calculations.
Crane access available from grade. Single mobilization with crane assumed.
All field work subject to King County prevailing wages (Ironworker rate). Certified payroll included.
AWS certified welder(s) per specification. Shop and field welding per AWS D1.1.
